exit 0
--- stdout
Manage admission limits: per resource class, how many canonical validation
commands may execute at once across canonical admission (submit-for-review,
update-review-commit, the orphaned-base heal) and the deferred-validation
runner. A command belongs to a class when its text contains any of the
class's --match substrings.
A command whose class is full waits in arrival order for a slot. The wait
does not count against its timeout_seconds budget. A submit waits up to the
engine cap of 14400 s minus its budget, but at least 2 h; other bounded
callers keep wait plus budget within the cap. A submit waits before it
prepares or rebases anything: if the class stays full it is refused as
RETRYABLE, and the same submission is simply retried. The deferred runner
waits until a slot frees.
Read the current limits with liza get config.admission_limits.
Identified agent sessions cannot use this command.
Usage:
liza admission-limit [command]
Available Commands:
remove Remove one admission limit
set Create or replace one admission limit
Flags:
-h, --help help for admission-limit
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza admission-limit [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
